read_source_snapshots.authority: Design alignment only. These hashes do not replace the future execution source freeze.

physics_lock.birth_mode: P24 only at new explicitly isotropic births

mode_semantics.baseline: Original bass_s9_vigilode::run and original FrozenBank evaluation.
mode_semantics.stream: Remove transient Vec allocations; retain node/cohort order and scalar Neumaier operation graph.
mode_semantics.prepared: Stream plus immutable per-bank mu^2/weight prepared data.
mode_semantics.cache: Prepared plus bounded bank-local exact-key RHS/Jacobian slots; recompute each Jv for the supplied direction.
mode_semantics.simd: Stable std::arch packed-f64 element operations, scalar ordered Neumaier reduction; runtime feature guard and scalar fallback.
mode_semantics.simd_cache: SIMD plus exact-key separate RHS/JVP slots.

dependencies.SIMD: stable std::arch; required packed f64 sqrt/div intrinsics are AVX; implementation may conservatively require AVX2 at runtime and must report this distinction
dependencies.rayon: 1.12.0 existing lock/vendor; independent input histories only

required: original S9 source hashes and immutable owner binding
rustc -Vv, cargo version, target triple, profile and feature flags
timing binary SHA256 and allocation binary SHA256 separately
exact command/environment/cwd plus monotonic wall clock scope
4 INPUT.json hashes and stored S9 raw/reference hashes
synthetic bank and query generator source hash plus materialized or canonical dataset digest
CPU/cgroup/RAM/disk quotas and effective worker/build caps
actual source publication and cloud readback state, without calling pending operations complete

release_comparison.profile: Both baseline and candidates in the same matched release build and binary; original S9 library is the baseline dependency.
release_comparison.stored_debug_comparison: Use unchanged S9 scientific gates against stored S8/analytic FLRW and original S9 RAW; no bitwise requirement across debug/release.
release_comparison.within_release_comparison: Strict f64 to_bits for kernel and exact canonical scientific receipt bytes/digest for histories, all six modes. Signed zero retained.
release_comparison.history_retained: All other original fields including input, observations, events, exact certificates, final cohorts, old-stock digests, segments, counters, status and failure.
release_comparison.failure_policy: A within-release difference is a FAILED_CANDIDATE even if scientific tolerances pass. Never accept by loosening tolerance or deleting a scientific field.

kernel.grid_order: nodes ascending outer loop, cohorts ascending inner loop; trace order changing then jvp_reuse

fixture.classification: Synthetic immutable possibly anisotropic frozen-stock kernel bank; not a P24 birth certificate or continuum-angular refinement.
fixture.reflection: exact dyadic mirrored pairs for n=16,64,256

query.order: Evaluate the source expression in its frozen Rust order. Changing calls eval; jvp_reuse calls jvp. Each batch restarts i=0.

identity_proof.note: Each comparison invokes baseline and tested mode, including the baseline-self mode. This is not 6912 independent scientific cases.

warmup.note: Follows identity probes; not a cold-cache measurement. Persistent evaluators are used across timed batches.

diagnostics.counters: Cache/kernel computation counters are workload observations, not elapsed-time measurements.

preparation.interpretation: Single preparation samples may be sub-microsecond/timer-noise dominated. Report separately; any break-even estimate is descriptive and workload-specific. Do not add repetitions after seeing times.

whole_history.full_raw_policy: Persist first warmup per case and mode. This is the representative receipt reused for all repeated scientific digests.
whole_history.timed_scope: Exactly one run_with_mode(owned_input,mode) call; caller input.clone before Instant, receipt remains live through elapsed read, hash/serialization/drop afterward. Internal receipt/input clones and setup performed by run_with_mode remain included.
whole_history.inference: Four unique existing physical workloads; performance repetitions are not new independent science cases.

parallel.pair_order: baseline,simd_cache for even rounds; reversed for odd rounds
parallel.pool_policy: New local Rayon pool per run_independent call; no global pool and no inner moment reduction/threading.
parallel.timed_scope: Includes pool construction and entire run_independent batch; input Vec clone and digest/file I/O/drop outside. Pool teardown follows the actual API boundary and is included when completed before return.
parallel.identity: Every ordered output digest equals the corresponding serial representative. Completion and input-index order mandatory.
parallel.interpretation: End-to-end four-job latency/throughput including per-call pool cost; not kernel-only scaling.

measures: total bytes requested by those calls
not_measured: allocation cost as a time fraction
allocation_probe.claim_rule: Never use instrumented durations for speedup. Atomic instrumentation is compiled out in the timing binary.

SIMD scalar fallback and vector tail n=4/6/16
large equal x and birth u without exponent splitting
separate RHS/JVP slots and new directions

new bank at same point; original evaluator stays immutable
nonfinite/invalid domain and direction error precedence; recovery

Rayon ordered output and worker cap
scientific comparator retains signed zero and status
C6_targeted_verification.FMA_negative_control: Not added: no FMA implementation is admitted. Existing signed-zero/status comparator control and operation-order review target the present risks.

planned_counts.interpretation: Counts bind to the inspected harness/tests at final freeze. New tests or schema changes require an explicit pre-run amendment, not retroactive count adjustment.

science_gates.scope: Original 68 applicable S9 quality-gate decisions for these four workloads; assess the new baseline release RAW and compare canonical identical candidates. No S8 ODE rerun.
required_structural_checks: unchanged old-stock raw data and digests
32 positive exact-admitted births and 33 fresh segments for each closed workload
0 births and 1 segment for each FLRW control
right-bank event output and event continuity
nonzero event callback jump where original donor transfer requires it
actual analytic JVP/Ft work for MF and direct/clock work for small mode
unchanged solver counters and output clipping within release

statistics.quantile: linear interpolation at (N-1)*p; for N=7, Q1=(s[1]+s[2])/2, Q3=(s[4]+s[5])/2 in zero-based sorted samples
statistics.never_pool_baseline: Each candidate uses its adjacent baseline sample. Baseline samples across candidates are not substitutes for pairing.
parallel_metrics: descriptive worker scaling T1/Tw and efficiency/(workers) with seven round-index ratios
statistics.worker_scaling_caveat: Workers are measured in separate blocks; round-index ratios are descriptive, not temporally adjacent causal comparisons.
statistics.preparation: Report median/IQR separately; no speedup claim when timer dominated.
statistics.normalization: micro seconds/calls; do not divide cache timing by theoretical full-ray visits as if all were evaluated.
statistics.short_sample_policy: Report SHORT_BATCH or TIMER_RESOLUTION_CAUTION; do not tune repeat count from observed elapsed time.
statistics.aggregation: Report all 18 kernel workloads and all 4 histories, including regressions. No unregistered weighted overall speedup.
no_claims: statistical population confidence from seven container samples
performance inferred solely from fewer counters/allocations

resources.owner_work: Preserve prior owner jobs and files.
resources.RSS: Only call it peak RSS with a measurement covering the whole relevant process tree/lifetime; sparse /proc samples are observed lower bounds.

DAG.action: Parent freezes source, protocol, datasets, environment/commands and publication/readback state.
One matched release timing build and separate allocation-feature build; record actual build timings outside benchmark. Productive compile repairs preserve receipts and rebind changed source.
Run only preregistered targeted changed-surface tests; preserve raw output and failure classes.
Sequential micro(including prepare), serial history, parallel batch, separate allocation probe. Fixed warmups/rounds; within-release equality gates are live.
Evaluate unchanged scientific gates on saved representative release RAW; compare stored S9/S8 and derive all performance statistics from saved samples only.
One parent-requested scope-bound independent review of implementation/bindings/raw/stats. No benchmark replay for agreement.
Publish scoped decisions, failed candidates and remaining duties; parent records GitHub plus two backup/readback states and updates both handoffs.

failure_policy.raw_preservation: Append raw JSONL/exit/time/command and failed scientific output when available. Never overwrite an old run directory.
failure_policy.retry: An unchanged failed operation gets at most one diagnostic retry. A diagnosed material repair is one scope-bounded repair episode with only affected reruns, new source/input identity and preserved old failures.
failure_policy.no_adaptive_sampling: No extra rounds, quicker inputs, tolerance widening or best-run selection after seeing a timing.
failure_policy.partial_results: A timeout/resource failure preserves completed pairs; incomplete seven-round cells are INCOMPLETE and cannot be silently promoted. Finish unaffected authorized analysis.
failure_policy.positive_exit: A passing gate advances to the next DAG node; finite review does not open another research cycle.

independent_review_plan.scope: Actual new kernel/cache/SIMD/runner changes; immutable bindings; strict comparisons; derived timing statistics and unchanged science gates.
physics_first: same non-tilted Bianchi I equations and fixed spectral/source authority
birth transfer and exact admission unchanged
no new approximation/closure or continuum inference
code_then: exact state/bank cache lifetime and direction recomputation
scientific field exclusions restricted to elapsed_seconds
timed boundaries, fixed sample counts, partial failures
independent_review_plan.verification: Read saved raw/counters and independently recompute small summary statistics; no same analyze function as sole evidence, no history integration or old campaign rerun.
independent_review_plan.budget: One scoped primary independent pass; at most one risk-justified fresh adversarial pass for an actual material defect under the skill policy.

primary_citations.claim: Elementwise SIMD and floating reduction reassociation are distinct; keep original scalar reduction order.
Runtime CPU feature guarding and scalar fallback for architecture intrinsics.
Packed f64 square root intrinsic requires AVX.
Packed f64 division intrinsic requires AVX.
Parallel reduction order is not a scalar floating reproducibility guarantee; parallelize independent histories.
Explicit local thread pool construction and configured worker count.
Accurate compensated arithmetic alone does not license arbitrary reduction ordering.
Approximate Jacobian reuse has method/order conditions; this design uses identical-point memoization only.
